title: Prompt for confirmation before running xargs command
summary: Use the interactive flag with xargs to ask for confirmation before executing the command for each set of arguments. This helps prevent accidental deletion or modification of files.

steps.explain: Add the --interactive flag to xargs. You will be prompted to confirm each command execution by typing 'y' or 'Y'.
